name: Glenfield

queries.query: site:linz.govt.nz New Zealand property parcels map API Auckland Glenfield cadastral
queries.result: First-party LINZ discovery identified the NZ Primary Parcels dataset, its public ArcGIS Online feature service, CRS, schema, and parcel-data scope.

queries.language: native/local (Māori; official operational source is English)
queries.query: site:linz.govt.nz Māori whenua parcels map API Auckland Glenfield
queries.result: First-party LINZ discovery returned Māori land cadastral guidance and the same national parcel source route; no separate Glenfield local cadastral custodian was evidenced.

registryBasis: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (LINZ) is the evidenced national cadastral custodian and publishes the NZ Primary Parcels dataset and anonymous ArcGIS REST service. No Glenfield or Auckland municipal cadastral service was independently evidenced in this attempt.

requests.outcome: Official LINZ dataset page identified current primary parcel polygons, public ArcGIS/OGC APIs, native CRS EPSG:4167 in page metadata, primary key id, and national parcel scope.
Official public ArcGIS item route identified feature service URL, public access, authoritative LINZ ownership, and service extent.
Anonymous item JSON returned the official public feature-service URL and public metadata; no credentials or private token used.

Anonymous layer metadata returned esriGeometryPolygon, native spatial reference WKID 2193 (NZGD2000 / New Zealand Transverse Mercator), objectIdField OBJECTID, stable native parcel field id, and maxRecordCount 2000. Unsafe fields were not requested in the parcel query.
Attempted with latitude,longitude in the ArcGIS x,y geometry parameter; returned zero features because ArcGIS expects longitude,latitude. This malformed request is not evidence of absence.
Corrected anonymous exact-point intersects query returned one polygon with safe native id 5176177 and full geometry transformed to EPSG:4326 for the retained sample; the WUP point was not shifted.

Bounded anonymous 0.02-degree envelope query returned three polygon features and exceededTransferLimit=true; retained only the exact-point feature to avoid unnecessary geometry and sample duplication.

source: LINZ NZ Primary Parcels ArcGIS FeatureServer layer 0

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: LINZ NZ Primary Parcels is a national current primary-parcel polygon layer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous public service metadata and one exact-point polygon response verified; a bounded local envelope also returned parcel polygons.

runtimeReadinessReason: A real public source and safe exact-point sample are evidenced, but runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial adapter qualification. This packet is not source integration or admission.
remainingUncertainty: No city-boundary clip or citywide completeness assessment was performed. LINZ is the national cadastral custodian; no separate Auckland/Glenfield local registry route was established. Exact-point presence does not imply citywide coverage.
